dependent_variable.name: binary_sentiment
dependent_variable.coding: Y=1 for ratings {4,5}; Y=0 for ratings {1,2}; rating 3 excluded
dependent_variable.rationale: Binary coding improves interpretability/actionability and reduces midpoint ambiguity; granularity loss is tracked through a non-binary sensitivity check.

stopping_justification.criterion: Stop model iteration when validation performance improvement is <= 0.005 for two consecutive model updates, or when additional complexity hurts generalization.
stopping_justification.evidence: No tracked validation metric variables were detected; use model comparison table already produced above.
